title: Dhwani TTS v1.8.0 Mega Update Released!
message:
1. Studio Clarity Engine: Vocalizer/Eloquence-like ultra-crisp sound, zero stuttering & zero-lag silence trimmer.
2. Smart Auto-Return: Automatically switches back to your chosen default voice after reading other languages.
3. A-to-Z Language Dropdown added in Voice Library.
4. Full Auto TTS & multilingual voice selector support.
